source_refs.note: Exercise 7.1, Question 4 (book p. 230); the book prints no answers for Exercise 7.1; answers checked with sympy and the solution book

blocks.prompt: 4 (a) A car is travelling along a straight road. At \(t = 0\) seconds, the car passes a point \(A\) with a velocity of 12 m/s, and this velocity is maintained up to \(t = 35\) seconds. The driver then applies the brakes, and the car decelerates uniformly, coming to rest at the point \(B\) at \(t = 40\) seconds. Sketch a velocity-time graph to illustrate the motion of the car.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh sketch ka sawal hai: humein alfaaz ko velocity-time graph ki shakal mein badalna hai.
Diya kya hai? 35 second tak 12 m/s ki constant velocity, phir brakes se uniform deceleration aur 40 second par car ruk jati hai.
Find kya karna hai? Velocity-time graph ka sketch.
Plan: constant velocity ka matlab horizontal line; uniform deceleration ka matlab neeche aati seedhi line.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(t = 0\) se \(t = 35\) s tak v = 12 m/s; phir uniform deceleration aur \(t = 40\) s par v = 0.
Maloom karna: velocity-time graph.
Tareeqa: Key Features of Velocity-Time Graph (7.1.5): a = 0 ho to graph horizontal line; a constant aur negative ho to graph seedhi neeche aati line.

Pehla hissa: constant velocity
\[(0, 12) \text{ to } (35, 12)\]
Kyun: velocity badal hi nahi rahi, is liye slope (acceleration) zero hai aur line bilkul horizontal hai, v = 12 ki oonchai par. Socho ke speedometer ki sui 35 second tak 12 par ruki rehti hai; graph mein yahi ek seedhi leti hui line ban jati hai.

Doosra hissa: uniform deceleration
\[(35, 12) \text{ to } (40, 0)\]
\[a = \dfrac{0 - 12}{40 - 35} = -2.4\text{ m/s}^2\]
Kyun: uniform deceleration ka matlab hai slope constant aur negative, is liye graph seedhi line ban kar time axis tak aata hai, jahan car ruk jati hai. Har second velocity 2.4 m/s kam hoti hai.
Dhyan dein: braking wali line ko curve na banayein; 'uniformly' ka matlab hai seedhi line.

Tasdeeq
\[12 - 2.4 \times 5 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(v = u + at\) se 5 second ki braking ke baad velocity theek zero aati hai, yani car \(t = 40\) s par rukti hai, jaisa sawal mein hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(t = 0\) se \(t = 35\) s tak \(v = 12\) m/s par horizontal line, phir seedhi line neeche \(t = 40\) s par \(v = 0\) tak (trapezium jaisi shakal); figure dekhiye.

answer_figure.alt: Velocity-time graph of the car: a horizontal line at v = 12 from t = 0 to t = 35, then a straight line down to v = 0 at t = 40; the area under it is a rectangle 420 plus a triangle 30.
answer_figure.caption: Question 4: velocity-time graph of the car from A to B (original drawing)

blocks.prompt: 4 (b) A car is travelling along a straight road. At \(t = 0\) seconds, the car passes a point \(A\) with a velocity of 12 m/s, and this velocity is maintained up to \(t = 35\) seconds. The driver then applies the brakes, and the car decelerates uniformly, coming to rest at the point \(B\) at \(t = 40\) seconds. Find the displacement from \(A\) to \(B\).
blocks.explanation:
Velocity-time graph ke neeche ka area displacement hota hai, aur graph humne part (a) mein bana liya hai.
Diya kya hai? Trapezium jis ke kone (0, 0), (0, 12), (35, 12), (40, 0) hain.
Find kya karna hai? A se B tak displacement.
Plan: trapezium ka area; tasdeeq rectangle aur triangle se.
steps:
Diya gaya: part (a) ka velocity-time graph.
Maloom karna: A se B tak displacement.
Tareeqa: displacement = velocity-time graph ke neeche ka area (7.1.5). Yeh shakal trapezium hai, is ka area \(\frac{1}{2}(a + b)h\).

Trapezium ki sides
\[a = 40,\quad b = 35\]
\[h = 12\]
Kyun: parallel sides neeche wali (time axis par 0 se 40) aur oopar wali (v = 12 par 0 se 35) hain. Height 12 hai.
Dhyan dein: oopar wali side 35 hai, 40 nahi, kyunke 35 ke baad line neeche aane lagti hai.

Area
\[x = \dfrac{1}{2}(40 + 35) \times 12\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}(75)(12) = 450\text{ m}\]
Kyun: trapezium ke area ka formula lagaya; units (m/s) zarb s = m.

Tasdeeq: rectangle jama triangle
\[12 \times 35 + \tfrac{1}{2} \times 5 \times 12\]
\[= 420 + 30 = 450 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: ek hi raftaar se chalne ka hissa rectangle banata hai aur uniform braking ka hissa triangle. Dono ka jama bhi 450 aaya, to jawab pakka hai. Yeh bhi dekhiye ke braking ke 5 second mein car sirf 30 m chali, jabke pehle 35 second mein 420 m; brakes lagne ke baad raftaar tezi se kam hoti hai.

blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 7.1 ke jawab chhape hue nahi hain. Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. Is liye aap apna jawab yahan wale jawab se mila kar dekh sakte hain.
